evidenceLayout: Per-plan evidence under tmp/sef-s733/<planId>/ with gate runs under tmp/sef-s733/<planId>/final/. Before repeating a gate run, move final/ to attempt-<n>/.

reviewContext.userProblem: edit update rejects null and [] for strokeDashArray; raster and PDF export render some glyphs as tofu with no warning and lint has no glyph-missing finding; box-node labels are always vertically centered and unknown visual.style keys are silently accepted.
requiredOutcomes: G1: null removes optional keys in update, [] for strokeDashArray means solid, required fields give a clear error; Bun and native tests.

G2: circled numbers 11-20 and wave dash render in PNG through fallback fonts on macOS; uncovered glyphs give an export warning with element id and code points and a lint glyph-missing finding on any page kind where coverage can be determined; native behaves the same; SVG unchanged.

G3: verticalAlign top, middle and bottom work in SVG, PNG, PDF, app canvas and lint geometry, middle is the default, existing documents are byte-identical; padding matches horizontal rules; unknown visual.style keys rejected with suggestions; help and docs updated.

Final: CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true mise run verify and CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true mise run test-cli pass, with a 3-attempt retry for native deadline timeouts, and CPU comparison against target/sef-baseline/nodetto-cli recorded.
nonGoals: Changing core mergeVisual, document migration, schema version change, inspector or canvas text editor changes, handoff, HTML, Mermaid or D2 changes, full system font scan, text-run splitter, rejecting style keys in connect.
Relaxing any deadline; binary-less native parity; pushes, tags, releases; server, auth or deployment code.
constraints: Small localized hunks in apps/cli/src/help.ts, docs/cli.md, apps/cli/src/commands.ts and packages/core/src/index.ts.
Strict TS, noUncheckedIndexedAccess-safe core, Boa rules.
Native deadline tests use a 3-attempt retry and a CPU comparison; deadlines are never relaxed; every verification command must exit 0 and run tests.
Default behavior changes only where requested; additions are backward compatible with existing documents.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: G1 is implemented in the CLI edit layer (apps/cli/src/edit/visual-patch.ts); core updateVisual and mergeVisual do not change.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Many app and core callers depend on core merge behavior. replaceVisual is already in the derived-command pipeline, and validation still runs after the merge.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Lock-only update patches still emit updateVisual, with null mapped to false.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: permittedCommands only lets that exact shape reach a locked element, so explicit unlocking keeps working.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Fallback fonts are a separate bounded FALLBACK_FONT_FILES list, loaded after the base faces and only when the base set lacks a needed glyph; FONT_FILES is unchanged.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Documents covered by the base set keep today's raster output, and the full system scan is never added to a path that lacks it.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Glyph coverage has its own page eligibility over all document pages; notation engines run only on notation pages.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: export can rasterize any page, and no notation rule gains a page kind. Non-notation pages without glyph rows stay out of the report, so existing output and failures do not change.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Box labels honor verticalAlign only with the visual.style.boxLabelAlign marker, read through boxLabelVerticalAlign in label-layout.ts.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Existing documents can already store verticalAlign with no effect, so the stored value alone cannot separate them from new requests. The marker keeps them byte-identical with no migration, and all surfaces read one function.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Unknown visual.style keys are rejected by checkVisualStyleFields with its own ranking, using VISUAL_STYLE_KEY_ORDER plus extensions as the valid keys.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The checkFields matcher cannot suggest verticalAlign for textVerticalAlign or valign, and a second key list would drift.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: The design's plan partition is refined into eight plans in two waves, with sef-08 owning the help and docs hunks.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The owner requires maximum concurrency. Files, contracts and behavior do not change, and dependencies exist only for real contracts.

intentionalTradeoffs: Partial visual.style patches now merge instead of replacing the stored object. This is the documented, requested behavior and changes results for callers relying on whole-object replacement.

Hand-written JSONL must include boxLabelAlign for verticalAlign to take effect on a box node, and draw.io imports stay centered while still storing and re-exporting alignment (user-qa Q1 default, open).
connect keeps accepting unknown visual.style keys (user-qa Q2 default, open).
Editing verticalAlign on a bound box removes its text-style link unless the patch sets textStyle, matching the app's typography edits.
No coverage result, warning or finding exists in the system-scan case (no FONT_FILES entry and no --font-dir), because scanning can take tens of seconds.

Accepted low residual risks: SEF1-STALE-WHERE-SNAPSHOT (impl-plans/active/sef-01-edit-visual-merge.md:53), SEF7-FIXTURE-RERUN (impl-plans/active/sef-07-glyph-export-lint.md) and SEF3-NATIVE-BASE-FACE (impl-plans/active/sef-03-font-coverage-host.md:147).

High residual risk until sef-03 runs: the per-character fallback, face order and macOS font paths are unconfirmed. sef-03 runs that gate first and must stop with a recorded blocker if it fails; a text-run splitter is not built.
supportedEdgeCases: Null under a missing style or semantic parent is stripped by the merge; removing the last style key removes style.
[] for strokeDashArray also clears a stored dash, and an explicit dash in the same patch wins; add keeps rejecting [].
Removing a required semantic field gives: update cannot remove required field "label" of node.generic. Unknown element types skip this check.
Locked elements can still be unlocked with locked: false and locked: null.
Default-ignorable code points are skipped; ASCII-only text opens no font; unreadable fallback or --font-dir faces are skipped.
Code points no element contains are reported on a page-level warning line; a line lists at most 16 code points, then and N more.
Lint: ERD-only documents with glyph rows exit 0 with the finding; without rows they keep LINT_NO_PAGES; --page resolves among notation pages first, then to pages with glyph rows.
Legacy unbound, bound, detached and draw.io-imported boxes without the marker render byte-identically; a bound box can follow a text style with boxLabelAlign alone.
bottom alignment clamps free space to 0, so text that does not fit starts at the top padding.
A null value for an unknown visual.style key is also rejected; extensions stays accepted; add with a shape preset is covered.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Desktop app raster paths, which have no resvg, usvg or fontdb.
text.note and sequence participant layouts, inspector controls for box nodes, canvas text editor position, code handoff, HTML bundle, Mermaid and D2 output.
Documents only read or validated keep the existing unknown-field warning path.
Coverage work for SVG and non-raster export formats.
